body.question: Is this county in air quality nonattainment, and how far is the nearest Class I federal area?

response.question: Is this county in air quality nonattainment, and how far is the nearest Class I federal area?
response.answer:
Loudoun County is in EPA NAAQS nonattainment for the 8-Hour Ozone (2015 Standard), meaning any new or modified combustion source (e.g., backup diesel generators, gas turbines) that clears major-source thresholds will face stricter Nonattainment New Source Review permitting, including emission offsets and best available control technology requirements — raising both cost and timeline.

The nearest Class I federal area is Shenandoah National Park, at a geodesic distance of approximately 63,478 meters (63.5 km). While that is well within the conventional 300 km PSD screening radius, a project at this coordinate that triggers PSD major-source thresholds would require mandatory Federal Land Manager consultation and visibility/air-quality-related-values modeling with Shenandoah NP — an additional permitting lead-time and cost escalator on top of the nonattainment NNSR obligations.
